FIELDS.NAME: Greenway Shopping Plaza
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Property Manager, Greenway Shopping Plaza, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Greenway Shopping Plaza operates as a retail shopping center that features a diverse mix of low to moderate-risk tenants, including professional offices, boutique retail stores, and various service-oriented businesses. Our facility consists of well-maintained storefronts, with amenities designed to enhance customer experience and provide convenience. We prioritize safety and compliance, implementing robust fire protection systems and regular maintenance schedules to ensure adherence to local safety regulations. The plaza is strategically located to attract steady foot traffic, supported by our mix of anchor tenants, which include a pharmacy and a coffee shop. Our well-established tenant relationships, documented maintenance practices, and proactive risk management contribute to our sound operational practices and positive claims history, further reinforcing our commitment to providing a safe and welcoming shopping environment.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not accept properties with a majority of high-risk tenants such as nightclubs, bars, cannabis dispensaries, or adult entertainment venues, and confirms that all properties are in compliance with local safety regulations, with no unresolved code violations. Additionally, the business does not engage with properties that have a history of frequent or severe claims, including those related to slip-and-fall, fire, or vandalism incidents, nor does it accept properties with significant deferred maintenance or structural deficiencies.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On July 15, 2022, a minor water leak from an aging pipe caused damage to the ceiling of one of the retail units, leading to repairs costing $5,000. The damage was promptly assessed and remediated, and there have been no further incidents since. The claim is currently closed and resolved.
FIELDS.Combined Single Limit: $1,000,000 combined single limit with a $1,000 deductible
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard security safe; Class B, UL-rated.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and 24-hour security patrols to enhance safety and deter theft.
